store: fresh temporary worklog store per measured run: `empty` scenarios start with no database (first-open schema bootstrap), `initialised` scenarios start from a fresh copy of an already-migrated seed store (warm invocation)

coldStart.label: wl --help (no data access)
coldStart.note: first in-process call in this process: also pays module-graph and JIT warm-up; warm per-call numbers exclude it

dominant.verdict: wl --help (no data access): dominant phase is Command construction + built-in registration — 1.2 ms, 63.4 % of the 1.9 ms call; so the fixable cost is harness-side (removable by reusing state across calls in the test harness).

wl list --json (first open, schema bootstrap): dominant phase is database open incl. schema/migrations — 1.6 ms, 43.8 % of the 3.6 ms call; so the fixable cost is production startup (a src/ change, not a test-only fix).

wl list --json (already-initialised store): dominant phase is Command construction + built-in registration — 1.3 ms, 51.2 % of the 2.5 ms call; so the fixable cost is harness-side (removable by reusing state across calls in the test harness).

scenarios.name: create
scenarios.label: wl create -t <fixture item> --json
scenarios.command: node src/cli.ts --worklog-dir <temp-store>/.worklog create -t In-process profile fixture item --json

dominant.verdict: wl create -t <fixture item> --json: dominant phase is command action (incl. config load + DB open) — 1.5 ms, 37.4 % of the 4 ms call; the call is dominated by the command’s own production work (the behaviour the test asserts), so no test-side reuse can remove it — the fixable remainder is harness-side (harness-side 1.5 ms, 37.9 %; production startup 0.8 ms, 20.8 %).

wl status --json: dominant phase is Command construction + built-in registration — 1.3 ms, 50.4 % of the 2.5 ms call; so the fixable cost is harness-side (removable by reusing state across calls in the test harness).
